text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornInAmericanCity(x) ::: x is born in an American City.
American(x) ::: x is an American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInAmericanCity(x) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in an American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Book(x) ∧ Novel(x)) → (WrittenBy(y, x) → NovelWriter(y))) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenInYear(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written by Dani Shapiro in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
BornInAmericanCity(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornInAmericanCity(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
